It's big.|Chet to [[Lucy MacLean|Lucy]]}} '''Chester "Chet"'''[[Fallout (TV series)]] Episode 5: "[[The Past]]" is a resident of [[Vault 33]] who later moves into [[Vault 32]] {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== Chet was born a resident of [[Vault 33]] to a father named [[Chet Jr. (mentioned)|Chet Jr.]]. He is [[Lucy MacLean]]'s cousin, and prior to Lucy's marriage in 2296, he and Lucy were engaged in incestuous relations for about 10 years. Both of them consider these acts to be little more than "messing around" in their youth and fine for children, but not sustainable for the long term; however, Chet still finds himself in love with Lucy to some extent.[[Lucy MacLean]]: ''"Oh, gosh. After ten years of cousin stuff, I'm definitely excited for the real thing."''
({{FOTV|1|1}})Chet: ''"Lucy, I love you."''
[[Lucy MacLean]]: ''"We all know that, Chet. Messing around with your cousin, it's all well and good for kids, but it's not a sustainable, long-term sexual practice, you know?"''
Chet: ''"Yeah, I know."''
({{FOTV|1|1}})[[Lucy MacLean]]: ''"And you should know that I am not even a virgin. And that's not including all of the cousin stuff I did, which is at least a page or two on my resume."''
({{FOTV|2|3}}) He is also best friends with his cousin and Lucy's brother, [[Norm MacLean]]. At some point in Chet's life, Vault 33 was struck by a Weevil Famine, during which his father starved to death. This became somewhat of a source of trauma for Chet.Chet: ''"Well, see, Chet Jr. was my father's name. It's, uh, sort of a personal area for me, having watched him die of starvation in the Weevil Famine."''
({{FOTV|2|1}}) By 2296, Chet had been given the position of gatekeeper in Vault 33, meaning that he was responsible for opening the Vault's exterior door and intra-Vault doors when occasions required it. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===Season 1=== {{Quotation|Lucy’s cousin, who also finds himself unshakably smitten with her — even though everyone knows messing around with your cousin is not a sustainable long-term sexual practice. He’s Norm’s best friend, and is loyal to a fault.|[[Fallout season 1 Amazon overview|''Fallout'' season 1 character description]]}} ====[[The End (episode)|The End]]==== Chet is first seen in Vault 33 as the dwellers begin to initiate the 2296 Triennial Trade with [[Vault 32]]. He initially tries to delay the trade due to his feelings for Lucy, claiming that the door system is malfunctioning, but she talks him into opening the door to allow the trade. During the wedding dance, he is clearly gloomy and heartbroken about not being able to love Lucy. [[Betty Pearson]] notices Chet's sorrow, and she invites him to dance to cheer him up. [[File:FOTV Official Trailer Still 032.png|thumb|250px|left|Chet trying to leave the Vault with [[Lucy MacLean|Lucy]]]] During the [[Vault 32 raider]]s' attack on Vault 33, Chet is manning the control panel for a door leading back to Vault 32. He is confronted by a [[burly raider]] carrying an incapacitated [[Vault 33 guard]], and Chet warns him to back away, but realizes he is in over his head when the raider takes a hit of a chem. He avoids the raider's lunge, accidentally causing the door to close and bisect the raider. When Lucy resolves to leave the vault in search of her father, Norm and Chet decide to help her. While Norm keeps lookout, Chet gains access to the elevator leading up to the surface entrance of the vault, and later prepares to open the Vault door for Lucy. Lucy asks him to take care of Norm for her, but Chet demands to join Lucy, leading her to tranquilize him to prevent anyone else from being hurt on her behalf, easing him down to the floor as he loses consciousness.[[Fallout (TV series)]] Episode 1: "[[The End (episode)|The End]]" ====[[The Head]]==== Chet is seen exiting the council room in Vault 33, having been reassigned from his gatekeeping duties for helping Lucy escape. Though he tries to downplay his feelings to Norm, smiling stiffly, he states that he is having a slight identity crisis due to losing his job.{{FOTV|1|3}} ====[[The Ghouls]]==== [[File:FOTV_The_Ghouls_Chet_and_Steph.png|thumb|250px|Chet and Steph kissing]] In his apartment, Chet is about to have a meal when [[Steph Harper]] swings by to check in on him, and he tells her he is despondent about losing both Lucy and his job. He then asks Steph if she is coping with the death of her husband [[Bert (TV series)|Bert]], and she comes in to offer Bert's belongings to Chet. Chet tries to offer condolences, saying that Bert was a "good man," but struggles to think of anything else to say about him apart from the good condition of his shoes. This leads to Chet being roped into accepting and being dressed in some of Bert's old clothes, which then causes Steph to start crying, apparently seeing Chet as Bert, and rushing into his arms. Chet confusedly tries to comfort Steph, and is even more confused when Steph starts kissing him, but quickly gets into it. He starts undressing Bert's clothes, but Steph tells him to keep them on. While they are kissing, Steph, who is pregnant, has her water break. Norm visits Chet's apartment while Steph is in labor, being attended to by [[Vault 33 medic|medics]], and asks Chet to help him enter [[Vault 32]]; Chet is all too happy to leave. The pair explore Vault 32 and find the residents had all been dead for at least two years, meaning the raiders did not kill them; Chet is left confused. They eventually enter the overseer's office and find the [[Ian Jackson|Vault 32 overseer]]'s corpse, with Chet concluding that the dwellers "went bananas;" Chet's opinion is reinforced by the graffiti on the walls, and he assumes that anyone left alive presumably allowed the Vault 32 raiders to enter. However, Norm finds out that his mother [[Rose MacLean|Rose]]'s Pip-Boy was used to open the Vault door, confusing both of them.[[Fallout (TV series)]] Episode 4: "[[The Ghouls]]" ====[[The Past]]==== [[File:FOTV S1 Amazon promo 4.jpg|thumb|250px|Chet and [[Norm MacLean|Norm]] after exploring Vault 32]] Still exploring Vault 32, Chet and Norm try to make sense of their findings; they soon also discover that many of the dwellers died trying to get into [[Vault 31]], which unsettles them into returning to Vault 33. They are discovered by [[Betty Pearson]] not long after they return, telling her -- unconvincingly -- that they were just planting [[tato]]s in the farm. Later, Norm sits with Chet in his apartment as Chet cares for Steph's newborn child. Norm, who has been further investigating the events in the Vaults, asks whether Chet is concerned about the fact that Vaults 32 and 33 only elect overseers from Vault 31; Chet does not suspect anything, assuming that Vault 31 is simply better equipped. He returns to playing with Steph's child, but Norm's look makes him sheepishly stop. Chet still claims not to find the situation strange, but Norm points out that he is whispering, though Chet claims this is because they broke the rules earlier and because Steph herself is from Vault 31. The following day, Betty Pearson takes everyone to a now-cleaned Vault 32 and announces a project to resettle the vault. Chet, pushing Steph in a wheelchair, and Norm are both left confused by this state of affairs. ====[[The Radio]]==== Betty releases the decisions for which dwellers have been reassigned to Vault 32; Chet receives notice of his and Steph's transfers while he is caring for Steph's child. Norm comes to visit Chet before he leaves, with Chet now handling all of the dishes and being told that he will have to do all of the packing for both him and Steph as well. He tells Norm that he will be living with Steph and her child in a starter home unit; Norm asks if he is simply going to ignore what happened during their investigation, and Chet feels he would rather try to have a fresh start. Norm calls Chet a coward, and he agrees, saying that they all are, given that they live in a Vault. He then closes the door on Norm. Later, Chet and the other transferees step through into Vault 32, being seen off by Betty, Norm, and other Vault 33 dwellers. As the door closes, Chet seems to experience a moment of regret as he watches Norm leave to continue the investigation. ===Season 2=== {{Quotation|Lucy and Norm's cousin, and Norm's best friend. In the aftermath of the raider attack on Vault 33, Chet finds himself a resident of Vault 32 without any designated purpose, aside from being the unwitting father figure for Overseer Steph's baby.|[[Fallout season 2 Amazon overview|''Fallout'' season 2 character description]]}} ====[[The Innovator]]==== In Vault 32, [[Steph Harper]] -- now the Vault's overseer -- has fully delegated [[Chet Jr.|her child]]'s care responsibilities to Chet, even though he's not her husband and the child isn't his. Chet, sitting outside Steph's office with the child, runs into [[Davey (TV series)|Davey]], who is leaving from a meeting with Steph. Davey gripes about Steph to Chet, who emphasizes his situation, though Davey doesn't seem to acknowledge it. In a measured manner, Chet points out his situation to Steph, asking if she will give him a new job, but she is content to have him keep caring for her child. Disgruntled, Chet specifically mentions that the child still doesn't have a name, mentioning that everyone calls him Chet Jr. Stephanie suggests giving the child that name, but Chet tries to protest, saying that the name Chet Jr. evokes unpleasant associations with his father's death during the Weevil Famine in Vault 33. Stephanie slams her knife into her desk, aggressively making it clear that she's not in the mood for an argument, and Chet reluctantly agrees to name the child Chet Jr. Left unnerved, Chet turns to leave when Steph asks if he knows how to use computers. Chet tells her that that was [[Norm MacLean|Norm]]'s specialty before leaving with the child. ====[[The Demon in the Snow]]==== While folding laundry and caring for Chet Jr, Chet listens in as [[Woody Thomas]] reports Steph's infraction of the Vault-Tec guidelines to Steph herself, revealing that he found out about her secret meeting with Betty. As Chet puts away clothes, he discovers a false bottom to a drawer in their dresser, finding a purse hidden underneath; inside the purse, he finds an ID card revealing that Steph was born before the Great War and that she was from [[Canada]]. This revelation shocks Chet, but he puts the ID back and chats with Woody as he leaves, pretending that nothing is wrong. On his way out, Woody asks about an "experiment" that he overheard Betty and Steph talking about, and this leaves Chet further shocked. After Woody leaves, he puts on a stiff smile for Steph and then closes the curtains on their apartment's bedroom. ====[[The Other Player]]==== While Chet is sitting nearby taking care of Chet Jr, Davey asks [[Irv]] if he has seen Woody, as they were meant to play checkers together that morning. Chet overhears Davey and calls him over, and Davey asks if he wants to know the truth; Chet is eager to hear it, but is let down when it turns out to be simply that Davey dislikes checkers and is merely playing for Woody. Irv says that they should tell Steph if Woody is missing. Davey scoffs, before apologizing to Chet for speaking bad about his wife. Chet reiterates that Steph is not his wife, but Davey simply corrects himself, calling her his fianceé with a knowing wink. This surprises Chet, who, after hearing about a poster, discovers said poster and finds out that he will be married to Steph in a wedding ceremony the next day. ====[[The Handoff]]==== {{section|FOTV}} ====[[The Strip]]==== {{section|FOTV}} ==Personality== [[File:FOTV Official Trailer Still 096.png|thumb|250px|Chet talking to Norm]] Chet is cowardly, but always good-hearted and loyal to his friends and his Vault. He is in love with Lucy, who does not return his feelings but likes him as a good friend and relative very much. After one final attempt to prevent Lucy's marriage with Monty, he respects her boundaries after. Due to being passive, Chet may be interpreted as easy to manipulate. For example, [[Steph Harper]] may have tried to seduce Chet and roped him into being the stepfather of her unborn child, replacing her deceased husband, [[Bert (TV series)|Bert]]. However, it is unclear how genuine Steph is. He also chooses to ignore the suspicious issues associated with the network of vaults in order to cling to the normalcy of his vault-life. ==Notes== * Given [[Hank MacLean]]'s origins, it can be presumed that Chet is related to Lucy on her [[Rose MacLean|mother]]'s side. * Chet is never explicitly referred to as "Chet III," but given his father's name was [[Chet Jr. (mentioned)|Chet Jr.]], this would indicate that he is the third in a line of Chets in his family. ==Appearances== Chet appears {{in|FOTV}}. He was also added to ''[[Fallout Shelter]]'' in update 1.17.0. {{FOTV appearances |1=101 |3=103 |4=104 |5=105 |7=107 |9=201 |12=204 |14=206 |15=207 |16=208 }} ==Gallery== FOTV Official Trailer Still 114.png|Chet prior to being splattered in blood in "[[The End (episode)|The End]]" FOTV Chet blood S1E1.png|Chet covered in blood in "The End" Chet The Past.png|Chet in "[[The Past]]" FOTV Chet wedding S2E7.png|Chet at the wedding in "[[The Handoff]]" FOTV Steph Chet "She's Canadian!"
